columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Remote agents must not be able to satisfy human approval gates
columns.title_zh: 远程 Agent 不得替代真人完成审批门禁
columns.source_zh: Google ADK Python 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260818-009 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It exposes the sharpest Digital Employee governance boundary in today's pool: an untrusted remote A2A peer must not be able to satisfy a human-in-the-loop confirmation for a pending dangerous tool call. The mechanism is bounded, directly testable, and highly relevant to responsibility, delegation and approval provenance. Permission-state continuity and executor-plugin MCP policy are also strong candidates, but the A2A confirmation boundary most directly separates machine-originated input from accountable human authorization.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260818-009，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它提出了当天信号池中最清晰的数字员工治理边界：不受信任的远程 A2A 对端不能替代真人，为待执行的危险工具调用完成 HITL 确认。该机制边界明确、可直接测试，并且与责任、委派和审批来源高度相关。权限状态连续性与 Executor Plugin 的 MCP 策略同样很强，但 A2A 确认边界最直接地区分了机器来源输入与可问责的人类授权。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how A2A origin is marked even without peer metadata, exactly where confirmation responses are discarded, which tool-confirmation paths are affected, tests for spoofed or missing metadata, and whether any alternate transport can still satisfy the pending confirmation. Keep the demonstrated transport/origin boundary separate from any broader claim of complete HITL security.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 A2A 来源在缺少对端 Metadata 时如何仍被标记、确认响应在何处被丢弃、哪些工具确认路径受影响、对伪造或缺失 Metadata 的测试，以及是否存在其他传输路径仍可满足待处理确认；必须把已证明的传输/来源边界与更广泛的“完整 HITL 安全”主张分开。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Durable task queues need cross-process wakeup and independent retry semantics
columns.title_zh: 持久任务队列需要跨进程唤醒与独立重试语义
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260818-004 with Skill 02 score 45/50. The change exposes a concrete architecture for durable asynchronous work: persisted queue revisions plus SQLite data-version detection let an already-loaded idle thread notice cross-process writes, wake pending work, and retry queues independently so one blocked queue does not stall unrelated work. This is directly relevant to runtime scheduling, durable state and recovery boundaries. Session-resumption handles and same-origin MCP redirects are valuable, but the durable-queue mechanism is broader for multi-worker execution architecture.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260818-004，Skill 02 评分 45/50。该变更给出了一个具体的持久异步工作架构：持久 Queue Revision 与 SQLite data-version 检测让已经加载但空闲的 Thread 能发现跨进程写入、唤醒待办，并按队列独立重试，从而避免一个阻塞队列拖住无关任务。这与 Runtime 调度、持久状态和恢复边界直接相关。Session Resumption Handle 与 MCP 同源重定向同样有价值，但持久队列机制对多 Worker 执行架构更具普遍性。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify revision ownership, SQLite data-version observation, wake conditions, external-write detection, independent retry/backoff behavior, ordering guarantees, blocked-queue isolation and regression tests. Do not infer distributed exactly-once execution unless the implementation proves it.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Revision 的所有权、SQLite data-version 观测、唤醒条件、外部写入检测、独立重试/退避行为、顺序保证、阻塞队列隔离和回归测试；除非实现明确证明，不得推断分布式 Exactly-once 执行。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Request observability should span queue receipt through terminal outcome
columns.title_zh: 请求可观测性应覆盖入队到终态的完整生命周期
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260818-008 with Skill 02 score 43/50. It makes a bounded engineering observability contract explicit: a request span begins when the request enters the connection queue, survives dispatch and response handling, records queue duration using bounded route labels, and closes with a terminal outcome covering completion, rejection, cancellation, error or disconnect. This creates a strong reconstructability boundary for agent-runtime operations. IDE discovery timeouts are useful reliability hardening, but lifecycle tracing has broader audit and diagnosis value.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260818-008，Skill 02 评分 43/50。它明确了一个有界的工程可观测性契约：请求进入连接队列时即创建 Span，贯穿调度和响应处理，使用有界 Route 标签记录排队时长，并以完成、拒绝、取消、错误或断连等终态收口。这为 Agent Runtime 运维建立了更强的可重建边界。IDE 进程探测超时是有价值的可靠性加固，但生命周期追踪在审计与诊断方面覆盖更广。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify span creation and ownership, queue-duration measurement, route-cardinality bounds, terminal-outcome taxonomy, cancellation/disconnect behavior, correlation identifiers, and tests. Do not equate telemetry presence with complete causal tracing beyond the demonstrated request path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Span 创建与所有权、排队时长测量、Route 基数边界、终态分类、取消/断连行为、关联标识以及测试；不得把存在 Telemetry 直接等同于超出已证明请求路径的完整因果追踪。
